node_1.subject: Bernard Lowe
node_1.description: This is Bernard Lowe's plan for Monday February 13: wake up and complete the morning routine at 7:00am, walk to Hobbs Cafe at 8:00 am, open Hobbs Cafe at 8:00 am, manage the cafe and monitor baristas from 8:00 am to 4:00 pm, close Hobbs Cafe at 4:00 pm, walk home at 4:00 pm, have dinner at 8:00 pm, go to bed at 11:00 pm.
